name: TX-19
label: Safe R

key_factors: District's R+25 partisan lean in deep-red West Texas
Republican Tom Sell's massive financial advantage ($2.1M raised plus $1.3M outside support vs. $31K for the Democrat)
Prediction markets price the Republican at 98%
Open seat with no incumbent penalty or benefit
model.rationale: The R+25 district lean and Sell's overwhelming fundraising and outside-spending edge make a Democratic upset implausible; markets agree at 98% Republican. The forecast stays near the fundamentals, with a slight Republican improvement reflecting the money gap.
model.watch: A major polling surprise or collapse in Republican turnout in a low-salience special-style race is the only realistic path to movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Jodey Arrington (R) is not on the ballot.

overview:
TX-19 is a deeply Republican West Texas seat that Jodey Arrington is leaving open. The partisan lean of R+25 gives the Republican nominee a large structural advantage, and no general-election polling exists to challenge that picture.

Tom Sell has raised over $2.1 million and benefits from roughly $1.3 million in outside support, while Democrat Kyle Rable has raised about $31,000. Prediction markets put Republican chances near 98%. The race is rated Safe Republican with high confidence.
